title: 有馬記念の後に・ジューショー？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara is finally able to enter the Arima Kinen, and as expected, she loses.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She says she enjoyed the race, but at the same time, she feels different from usual…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to understand what exactly is making her feel this way, she decides to re-enter the Arima Kinen next year.
